title: messaging: delivery_id on inbox and receipt rows is declared as a link to the outbox row but no writer ever fills it
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

Filing category: ① product defect, implement-or-retire (escalated by the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review of PR #32490 for #32444, comment 6811790848; read from the code, not run).
Refs #32444

## Business reason

An administrator reading an inbox message or a notification receipt sees a `delivery_id` column that the object says links the row to its outbox delivery. It is always empty, so it cannot be used to trace a message back to the delivery that produced it, and the column only adds noise to the console and the API.

## What happens

1. `sys_inbox_message` declares `delivery_id` (`inbox-message.object.ts`, the header comment says it "links to the outbox row"). The inbox channel's insert never sets it.
2. `sys_notification_receipt` declares `delivery_id` the same way (`notification-receipt.object.ts`). Both receipt writers set it to `null`: `inbox-channel.ts` and `messaging-service.ts`.
3. PR #32490 rewrites the help text so it says honestly that the column is not filled in. It does not wire or remove the column; that choice is this card.

## Expected

One of:

- **Implement:** the writers set `delivery_id` to the outbox row that produced the inbox row or receipt, so the link works as declared; or
- **Retire:** remove the field from both objects (with the generated translations, baselines and any pin tests), under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove.

Re-check (premise): `git grep -n "delivery_id" -- packages/services/service-messaging/src ':!*.test.ts' ':!*generated*'` and confirm no writer sets a non-null value.
Reader who acts: the seat that owns `packages/services/service-messaging`.
